mu_name_from: MuMain loads the second classes' bare bodies as MODEL_BODY_HELM + MAX_CLASS + i from Data\\Player\\HelmClass2{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp:121-127), and GetSkinModelIndex hands CLASS_SOULMASTER, CLASS_BLADEKNIGHT and CLASS_MUSEELF skins 7, 8 and 9 (_enum.h:3250-3252, CharacterManager.cpp:240-254): Class201 the Soul Master, 202 the Blade Knight, 203 the Muse Elf.
why_this_one: Sevina's class change (the user, 2026-10-04: 'second class quest where char beccomes second class with new skins'; 'MU's way': the second class's body under any slot left empty). docs/class-change-quest.md.
sheet_from: Data/Player/level_man033.OZJ (256x256), from MuMain. All five of the Muse Elf's parts name it.
rebind_from: As HelmClass03: MU binds the base of the neck rigidly to Bip01 Spine1 and the rest of the head to Bip01 Head, and the head turns a long way from the chest.
cull_from: As HelmClass03's: MU's hair is single-sided fins.
material_note: Skin, all three: the face and hair are one island here (HelmClass03 had the hair apart), and the face is what a close look reads; the two small islands are the ears.
